Job Description :

• Carry out wet lab analysis according to applicable IK procedures and input into the SAP program
• Carry out test preparations, including preparing the required reagents
• Capable of operating laboratory equipment in accordance with the specific duties associated with each parameter
• Perform validation/verification of analytical methods
• Evaluate the analysis process and results that do not meet requirements
• Prepare the reagents used and ensure their quality
• Maintain records of reagent and glassware stock
• Perform routine maintenance of laboratory equipment and monitor room conditions
• Implement K3 and 5S programs in the work environment

Job Qualification :

• Minimum Bachelor's degree (S1) in Chemistry for fresh graduates
• Not colorblind
• Free from illicit drug use
• Willing to work shifts
• No dust allergies
• High level of initiative and integrity
• Good communication skills
• Able to work well both independently and in a team

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

• Melaksanakan analisis wet lab sesuai dengan prosedur IK (Instruksi Kerja) yang berlaku dan melakukan input hasil analisis ke dalam program SAP.
• Melakukan persiapan pengujian, termasuk menyiapkan reagen yang diperlukan.
• Mampu mengoperasikan peralatan laboratorium sesuai dengan tugas dan parameter analisis yang menjadi tanggung jawabnya.
• Melakukan validasi/verifikasi metode analisis.
• Mengevaluasi proses analisis dan hasil pengujian yang tidak memenuhi persyaratan atau spesifikasi.
• Menyiapkan reagen yang digunakan serta memastikan kualitas reagen tersebut.
• Memelihara catatan dan melakukan monitoring terhadap stok reagen dan peralatan gelas laboratorium (glassware).
• Melakukan pemeliharaan rutin terhadap peralatan laboratorium serta memantau kondisi ruangan laboratorium.
• Menerapkan program K3 (Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja) serta 5S di lingkungan kerja.

Kualifikasi Pekerjaan

• Minimal pendidikan S1 Kimia, terbuka untuk fresh graduate.
• Tidak buta warna.
• Bebas dari penyalahgunaan narkoba dan obat-obatan terlarang.
• Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift.
• Tidak memiliki alergi terhadap debu.
• Memiliki tingkat inisiatif dan integritas yang tinggi.
• Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik.
• Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. wo-jpfa-JR5135.d:
PT JAPFA FOOD INDONESIA (WONOAYU)

Job Responsibilities
* Perform thorough cleaning and sanitization of production machinery, equipment, facilities, and work areas in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Handle, mix, and apply sanitation chemicals and cleaning agents safely and in correct dilutions.
* Conduct pre-operative inspections to ensure all equipment is free of contaminants before production runs begin.
* Adhere strictly to company safety guidelines, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP), and occupational health and safety regulations.
* Document and maintain accurate records of sanitation activities, chemical usage, and inspection checklists.
* Report any equipment malfunctions, safety hazards, or pest control issues to the supervisor immediately.
* Assist in waste management and disposal processes in compliance with environmental and company policies.

Job Qualifications
* Proven experience as a Sanitation Operator, Cleaner, or in a similar role within the food processing, animal feed, or manufacturing industry is highly advantageous.
* Basic understanding of food safety standards, GMP, and the safe handling of industrial cleaning chemicals.
* Physical stamina and ability to perform manual labor, including lifting heavy loads, bending, and standing for extended periods in various temperature environments.
* Strong attention to detail, discipline, and a high level of commitment to hygiene and safety protocols.
* Ability to work effectively in a team and adaptability to work in shifts, including night shifts and weekends when required.
